title: Agent Baseline Capabilities and Incompatibilities Matrix
description: Baseline capabilities of deployed l4tools v1.7.7 on terminal/host

min_os_version.windows_name: Windows 7 SP1 (or Windows Server 2008 R2 SP1)

7000.name: CMD_DIAG_STREAM_CONTROL
7000.default_transport: rtp_over_udp -> leo4proxy L4RTP/1 mTLS tunnel -> l4media ingress (dev.leo4.ru:8443)

7002.name: CMD_DIAG_CANCEL
7002.description: Terminates active process tree spawned by 7001 execution task

known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.issue: Direct input injection (mouse/keyboard) is rejected if desktop is locked (WTS_SESSION_LOCK) or user session is unavailable.
known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.mitigation: Agent returns desktop_locked=true or session_unavailable=true in stream status; frontend must inform operator.

known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.issue: Ctrl+Alt+Del injection requires elevated SYSTEM service with Secure Desktop interaction or software SAS policy enabled.
known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.mitigation: Handled via shortcut_action 'ctrl_alt_del' using SendSAS / simulated credential manager where supported.

known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.issue: Windows 7 SP1 out-of-the-box does not support modern TLS 1.3 or ECDHE ciphers without KB3140245.
known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.mitigation: leo4proxy uses Windows SChannel API with client certificate in LocalMachine store, connecting to Nginx mTLS port 8443 and Mosquitto bridge on 8883.

known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.issue: Agent supports exactly one concurrent active video stream at a time per terminal.
known_incompatibilities_and_constraints.mitigation: Attempting stream_start while a stream is running returns already_running or performs controlled switch if requested.
